trigger: a future edit that weakens the guard's path-shape check, sidecar scan, ancestor walk, identity compare or snapshot handling
classification_rationale: shadow-header mutants of the guard survived the portable suite (security-guardian 6 of 72, quality-engineer 33 of 157, unhappy-path 8 of 21, happy-path 3 of 6, consistency-auditor one token); the same gaps exist at the base, the lift only made the guard shared; the shipped guard refuses correctly today, so no wrong outcome occurs (E6)
summary: Guard seams that no portable test pinned: a vanished sidecar ending the scan early, the ancestor loop's break, the sidecar listing bound, malformed and ordinary path shapes and the parts.empty() guard, 2 of 17 identity bytes and the volume serial's high bits, the snapshot fail-closed and a refused hive keeping no snapshot, a reparse point in the listing outranking a later entry's failure, the count cap outranking a listing failure, hive_reparse_point through the guard. Closed by new fake-probe cases that record every probe question with its path arguments and pin the exact sequence; the 36 mutants the orchestrator ran across the gates (the limits, the deadline order, argument fidelity, the survivors the reviewers reported, and the plugin's unload reporting narrowed to a good read) each fail the suite at the intended assertion (runs recorded in the gate-run notes).

trigger: a second consumer discards the string returned by before_load or after_load
classification_rationale: every other result-bearing function in the header is [[nodiscard]]; a dropped verdict compiled silently (probe); the sole consumer returns the token, so the control holds today
summary: before_load, after_load and read_sidecars were not [[nodiscard]]. Added; every call site in the tree consumes the value (compiled clean under -Werror=unused-result on clang and mingw).

trigger: a second-plugin author relies on a redirected path always yielding hive_path_redirected
classification_rationale: the comment said path facts come first so a UNC/redirected target is refused before any leaf fact is trusted; hive_path_redirected is the ninth check (probe-verified); every case still refuses, only the reported token differs
summary: The classify_hive_file comment overstated the check order; rewritten to name the groups in their real order and to say the first true fact is reported.

trigger: a reader or second-plugin author of the shared headers
classification_rationale: text moved verbatim into a header offered to a second plugin, plus wording this range wrote
summary: Wording fixes in the shared headers and tests: the probe block's account of opens (file-handle opens only; neither drive_type nor list_sidecars opens one), the banner's supplied/unguarded sentence and both swap residuals, the plugin-specific token prefix, the directive comment, hook wiring by reference to one instance and how to say no deadline, a misplaced divider for two wait constants, test and section titles and glue comments.

trigger: a by-name test selection or the CI flake-retry isolating the new case
classification_rationale: Catch2 splits a by-name selection at a comma, so a comma-named case matches nothing and the flake-retry cannot isolate it; 14 older cases in the file share the trait and are left as they were
summary: The sequence test this range added had commas in its name; renamed. The other new cases are comma-free.

trigger: the change is raised with the Windows Measured cell unchanged
classification_rationale: the cell says the lift was verified at its final head and that later commits change comments, docs and generated JSON only; later commits changed code (a production type-name spelling, the attributes, a qualifier, tests); also unbound to a SHA, host and board entry; found by 8 reporters, known open by gate order
summary: Re-pointed at the final native run in the docs-only commit 8d253f4bc: kingsley, Windows 11, native MSVC, an elevated user at High integrity with the backup and restore privileges, [privacy_permissions] at ea254770f, 109 cases and 1403 assertions, zero skips; the code differences from the lift are named (the attributes, the qualification, the moved directive); both shared headers are named in caveat 4; the plugin-docs JSON is regenerated with plugin_doc_gen --all.

trigger: an operator sees hive_stat_failed from an unreadable sidecar or a failed post-load re-read
classification_rationale: the README says the file or an ancestor could not be inspected; the guard also emits the token for a sidecar open, a sidecar listing and the post-load re-read (scratch run confirmed); the advice that follows still holds
summary: Widened in the docs-only commit 8d253f4bc to cover a sidecar open or listing and the post-load re-read.

trigger: a second consumer wires one hook, a copy of the guard, an empty deadline, or a different SID for the guard and for with_user_hive
classification_rationale: wiring both hooks to one instance is convention not type; the sole consumer wires it correctly and an empty deadline throws before any probe call; every miswire fails closed or visibly except a before-only wiring, which drops the post-load re-check; E6 caps it (no wrong outcome in production); the link target #5291 is open and labelled governance-deferred and tech-debt, not roadmap-parked, and is the tracker for making the guard the default for every consumer
summary: Found by plugin-developer (pd-1, pd-2), architect (arch-1), security-guardian (sg-2), unhappy-path (RR-03, RR-15, RR-21) and cpp-expert. The API shape is unchanged by a relocation. Folded into the tracker: one adapter beside with_user_hive that owns the probe, the guard and both hooks, a default for the deadline, and the SID passed once.

trigger: a second consumer declares or imports a same-named entity; win_profiles.hpp is edited without a security review
classification_rationale: UniqueHandle, FindHandle and LocalFreeGuard are generic owners in a hive-specific header and now have external linkage in yuzu::win; the tests and the fake are plugin-owned (no module suite or tag); win_profiles.hpp is named in none of the four routed tables, so an edit to it routes no security-guardian or cpp-safety review
summary: Design debt for the follow-up that makes the guard the default: move the owners to a handle header, nest or prefix the hive types, add a module-named test suite, and add a routed row for the shared loader.

trigger: a new implementer copies the raw-code shape
classification_rationale: docs/cpp-conventions.md forbids raw error codes and output parameters in new code and has no waiver clause; the header declares an exception in its own comment; the seam's shape is what the native evidence verified
summary: Accepted for a relocation; the shape decision belongs with the next consumer and the tracker.

trigger: the budget lapses during the ancestor, leaf or sidecar calls; an operator looks for a log line after a refusal
classification_rationale: the deadline is polled once at the top of before_load (about 100 attribute-only probe calls at most); a guard refusal yields a result row but no agent-log line; the lock-hold warning is tagged generically; all identical at the base
summary: Recorded observations; re-polling before the guard returns would be a behaviour change, so it is not part of a relocation.

trigger: a reader of the run's resource ledger
classification_rationale: the first run's ledger omitted that FindHandle and LocalFreeGuard are non-copyable and non-movable and did not itemise the by-reference callback contexts at the production call site; both are true against the code
summary: Carried in the second run's resource ledger committed with this fragment.

trigger: a future edit leaks a handle on one early return of the Win32 shell
classification_rationale: in-process handle counts are environment-sensitive on the shared CI runners and the plugin is default-off; the three owners are proven non-copyable, non-movable and nothrow-destructible by compile-time assertions, and the Windows TU compiles to identical machine code before and after the move
summary: No Windows handle-count test added; recorded as a hardening idea for the follow-up tracker.

trigger: a future edit swaps two adjacent checks, or a consumer reuses a guard or passes an empty or lower-case SID
classification_rationale: swapping two adjacent classifier checks changes only which token is reported, and the corrected comment says so; a refused second before_load on a reused guard, an empty deadline and an empty SID have no in-contract trigger (the SDK path wires one guard per load and the plugin rejects an invalid SID first)
summary: Not pinned; the hazards that are reachable by a second consumer are listed in the tracker finding.

trigger: a second consumer or a hostile profile owner compounds two of the recorded risks
classification_rationale: planning output only; the chaos design found no scenario that gates this push
summary: Six scenarios designed (CH-1 swap at every probe step on the fake; CH-2 a refusal plus a failed unload at the row-assembly level -- adopted and pinned in this range; CH-3 a misuse matrix for a second consumer; CH-4 an owner racing the real load; CH-5 a deadline that lapses under the lock; CH-6 a refusal or throw whose unload also fails). CH-1, CH-3, CH-4, CH-5 and CH-6 go to the follow-up tracker as hardening.
